items.q: Chauncey Morehouse, who may some day go down in musical history along with other instrumental inventors such as the Frenchman Sachs

ctx.x: Library. In the Belgian Congo, he learned that a tribe known for its elaborate drum music, the natives used no melody instruments but contrived their music from intricate drum sets. In a New York public library, he also discovered music manuscripts of original African chants and adapted this native music to modern jazz interpretation. ultimate success. After three years of patient experimenting, Morehouse was able to present his N'goma drums to the music world and public at large. Aside from the fact that N'goma drums are an important innovation to jazz music, they have immense possibilities in symphonic music, according to Irving Mills, music impressario and Morehouse's manager.
